value.rationale: Prescribing axis directions while optimizing all offsets is a natural constrained version of a current cylinder-packing question, not an arbitrary numerical slice. The result yields an all-angle exact optimum with a non-symmetric optimal placement in one regime, a strict chirality/sign transition at mutually orthogonal directions, and an independent two-to-three tangency transition. This supplies motivated structural classification beyond the already known unconstrained R3.
